svg.text: K1 closes only while PERMIT (GPIO25) is high AND HEARTBEAT (GPIO23) keeps toggling. Every +5V tag joins the ESP32 5V/VIN pin; every GND tag joins ESP32 GND.
top view · dot/notch = pin 1 · use a socket
FEEDBACK (≈3.3 V when K1 is on)
Resistor bands are for common 4-band 5% parts; 1% parts have 5 bands (10k = brown-black-black-red-brown).
Q1 tab is the drain: keep it off
= dead short when K1 turns on.
Test K1 contacts with a meter
